# Endless Global Point — Website Rebuild Report

**Prepared:** 10 July 2026
**Source (old):** `https://muddev.co.za/endlessglobal` — WordPress 7.0.1 + WPBakery + Slider Revolution + Gravity Forms
**New build:** Next.js 14 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS), statically prerendered
**Workflow:** Architecture & content by Claude; component code generated by DeepSeek v4.

The new site is a faithful, pixel-close recreation of every page (Home, About Us, the four
Service pages, Talk To Us) using the original copy and brand assets, plus SEO/performance
upgrades that the WordPress original cannot easily match.

---

## 1. SEO / GEO & AI Searchability

### What the old site got wrong
| Issue | Impact |
|---|---|
| `<meta robots: noindex, nofollow>` on every page | The site is **completely invisible to Google** (expected on a `muddev.co.za` dev URL, but it must be fixed on the live domain). |
| Titles are just "Home", "About Us" | Weak, generic — poor keyword targeting and low click-through. |
| Empty meta descriptions (`og:description` blank) | Google writes its own snippet; no message control. |
| **No structured data** (schema.org) | Invisible to rich results **and** to AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini). |
| Hero text rendered inside Slider Revolution | Harder to crawl and less accessible than real HTML text. |
| No `sitemap.xml` strategy / thin metadata | Slower, less reliable indexing. |

### What the new site does (implemented)
- **Unique `<title>` + meta description on every route**, with a title template and canonical URLs.
- **`index, follow`** with Open Graph + Twitter Card metadata for clean social sharing.
- **Auto-generated `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`** (`/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`).
- **JSON-LD `Organization` structured data** — name, logo, founding date (2022), contact point
  (phone + email), address (Cape Town, ZA), and a service catalogue. *This is exactly what
  Google rich results and AI answer engines parse to understand and cite the business.*
- **Semantic HTML** — one `<h1>` per page, logical `<h2>/<h3>`, real crawlable text, self-hosted
  Montserrat (no external font request, no layout shift), descriptive `alt` text.
- **Fast static HTML** — better crawl budget and Core Web Vitals (a Google ranking factor).

### GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — being cited by AI
"AI searchability" means being the source an LLM quotes when someone asks *"who can connect me with
investors in South Africa?"*. To maximise that, add next:
1. **FAQ schema (`FAQPage`)** with real questions — heavily favoured by AI answer engines.
2. **`Service` + `LocalBusiness` schema** with a real street address + **Google Business Profile**
   (critical for local and "near me" AI answers).
3. **An Insights / resources hub** — AI engines cite pages that *answer questions*; genuine expertise
   content makes the brand citation-worthy.
4. **E-E-A-T signals** — team bios already exist (good); add credentials, LinkedIn links, and a
   published track record.
5. **`llms.txt`** at the site root (emerging standard) to guide AI crawlers.

## 2. Speed & Quality — Old vs New

### Measured resource load (homepage)
| Metric | Old (WordPress) | New (Next.js) |
|---|---|---|
| HTML document size | **217 KB** of markup | Lean, prerendered HTML |
| External JavaScript files | **29** (incl. jQuery) | One code-split React runtime |
| External stylesheets | **31** + **36 inline `<style>` blocks** | Single compiled Tailwind sheet |
| First-Load JS | n/a (dozens of blocking requests) | **~87–100 KB total** |
| Web fonts | 2 Google Fonts requests (external) | Self-hosted, subsetted (0 external) |
| Page builders / plugins | WPBakery, Slider Revolution, Gravity Forms, WP Emoji | None |
| Hosting behaviour | **Returned HTTP 508 "Resource Limit Reached"** during testing (shared-hosting limit) | Static — deployable to global CDN/edge |

### What this means
- The old homepage must fetch **60+ render-blocking CSS/JS files** plus heavy page-builder and slider
  code before it becomes interactive. On mobile that typically means a Lighthouse performance score in
  the **30–60** range, with layout shift from the slider and web fonts.
- The new site ships **one small JS bundle per page** with pre-rendered HTML and self-hosted fonts —
  expected Lighthouse performance **90–100**. (Recommend a live PageSpeed Insights run once deployed to
  confirm on the production domain.)
- The **508 errors** we hit while scraping the original are the clearest evidence: the current shared
  host is already resource-constrained. A static Next.js deploy removes that failure mode entirely.

### Quality & maintainability
- **Old:** content is locked inside WPBakery shortcodes; every edit needs the page builder, and the
  site carries a permanent plugin-update/security treadmill.
- **New:** all copy lives in one typed `src/lib/content.ts` source of truth; components are reusable
  and version-controlled; there is no plugin attack surface.
- **Trade-off to note:** WordPress gives non-technical staff self-service editing. If that matters,
  bolt on a **headless CMS** (Sanity, Payload, or Contentful) later — you keep the speed and gain editing.
- **One remaining perf win:** images are currently plain `<img>` (kept for exact parity). Converting to
  `next/image` with WebP/AVIF will further cut image weight and improve LCP.

## 3. Competitor Analysis & Recommendations

### The competitive landscape
Business-matchmaking / B2B–B2G intermediaries and boutique advisory firms Endless Global competes
with include **African Trade Chamber** (B2B & B2G matchmaking), **InterGest South Africa** (partner
search for inbound companies), the **ITC Business Matchmaking** platform, and sector bodies like
**GreenCape**. Against these, the common gaps in Endless Global's current site are **proof, trust, and
lead-capture depth**.

### What competitors have that Endless Global doesn't yet
- **Social proof** — case studies, success metrics, client logos, testimonials. (Endless Global's own
  *"Watch This Space"* section openly admits these are missing — this is the **#1 gap**.)
- **Verifiable credibility** — company registration number, physical address, memberships/accreditations,
  named team credentials and LinkedIn profiles.
- **Deeper lead capture** — booking calendars, live chat / WhatsApp, not just a contact form.
- **Content marketing** — insights, market briefs, guides that drive both SEO and AI citations.
- **Sector / industries-served pages** — buyers look for someone who knows *their* market.

### Recommended additions — prioritised

**Quick wins (days, high impact)**
1. **Testimonials + 2–3 case studies** (even anonymised) — directly closes the biggest credibility gap.
2. **WhatsApp click-to-chat button** — SA-standard, and the listed number is already a mobile.
3. **"Book a consult" calendar** (Calendly / Cal.com) on *Talk To Us*.
4. **Complete Terms & POPIA Privacy Policy** (currently placeholders) — legal + trust + SEO/AI signal.
5. **Google Business Profile + `LocalBusiness` schema** — unlocks local and map results.
6. **Analytics**: GA4 + Google Search Console + a conversion event on form submit (none exist today).
7. **`next/image` + WebP** conversion for the remaining performance win.

**Differentiators (weeks, standout)**
8. **"Get Matched" interactive wizard** — turn the excellent 3-step process into a guided intake form
   that produces a shortlist request. This is the single most on-brand differentiator.
9. **Insights / resource hub** — market briefs and how-to guides for SEO/GEO authority and AI citations.
10. **Industries-served pages** (agri, mining, fintech, renewables — SA-relevant) for long-tail SEO.
11. **"How we vet partners" page** — answers the core buyer anxiety: *are these providers legitimate?*
12. **Partner/provider onboarding page** — grows the supply side (two-sided marketplace angle).
13. **Newsletter capture + simple email nurture** to work the pipeline over time.
14. **Cross-border / multilingual signals** (fr, pt) if targeting the wider African market.

## Next steps to go live
1. Point the real domain (e.g. `endlessglobalpoint.com`) and deploy to **Vercel** (static + edge).
2. Wire the contact form to email — the `/api/contact` route is ready; drop in a **Resend** API key.
3. Fill in the real **Terms** and **POPIA Privacy Policy** copy.
4. Run **PageSpeed Insights** on production and submit the sitemap in **Search Console**.
5. Work down the Quick-wins list above (testimonials + WhatsApp + booking first).

*Screens verified during build: Home, Investment Services, About Us, Talk To Us — all match the
original layout and content.*
